description: What scripts/run-tests.mjs does not run from test/*.mjs (RR-46). A new Node test needs no entry; add a file here only when it is a helper, fixture or harness, or a test that another step runs (font-licenses.mjs runs in check:fonts). Files named *-browser*.mjs are browser suites (test/browser-suites.json, scripts/quarantine.mjs) and are skipped by name.
